architectural_and_technical_documents.tower_and_building_floor_plans: Available (Official Project Page / Brochure) — Building/cluster layouts for Phased Masterplan Buildings, Towers & Villas (18+ mid-rise residential buildings (Cyan, Azure, Sapphire, Mesk, Jawaheer, Rimal, Kristal), 4- & 5-star hotels, 900m promenade) (Mid-Rise (G+P+7 to G+15) & High-Rise Towers (G+20 to G+45) + G+1/G+2 Villas) verified via https://maryamisland.ae/cyan-beach-residences/ and https://www.bayut.com/floor-plans/sharjah/maryam-island/.
architectural_and_technical_documents.typical_floor_plans_and_plates: Available (Official Project Page / Brochure) — 2D/3D typical floor plates and villa/apartment layouts documented at https://maryamisland.ae/cyan-beach-residences/ and https://www.bayut.com/floor-plans/sharjah/maryam-island/ covering Studios (365–490 sq.ft.), 1BR (660–910 sq.ft.), 2BR (1,050–1,580 sq.ft.), 3BR+ & Penthouses (1,650–5,500 sq.ft.), 3BR–6BR Villas/Townhouses (2,200–9,500 sq.ft.).
architectural_and_technical_documents.elevations_and_building_sections: Available (Official Project Page / Brochure) — Exterior architectural elevations, massing renders, and podium/facade profiles (Mid-Rise (G+P+7 to G+15) & High-Rise Towers (G+20 to G+45) + G+1/G+2 Villas) published in official project dossier (https://maryamisland.ae/about/); CAD/BIM working sections restricted to main contractor (Contractors: Beijing Emirates Construction, Civilco Civil Engineering, Unibeton).
architectural_and_technical_documents.apartment_configuration_and_area_schedul: Available (Official Project Page / Brochure) — Total inventory of 3,500+ units with unit area schedule: Studios (365–490 sq.ft.), 1BR (660–910 sq.ft.), 2BR (1,050–1,580 sq.ft.), 3BR+ & Penthouses (1,650–5,500 sq.ft.), 3BR–6BR Villas/Townhouses (2,200–9,500 sq.ft.) (verified via https://maryamisland.ae/cyan-beach-residences/).
architectural_and_technical_documents.landscape_and_infrastructure_plan: Available (Official Project Page / Brochure) — Community parks, waterfront/lagoon promenades, pedestrian spines, and district utility tie-ins detailed in https://maryamisland.ae/maryam-beach-residence/ (linked to FAC-SHJ-03 (University of Khorfakkan & Victoria International School Sharjah (VISS)) • FAC-SHJ-05 (Burjeel Specialty Hospital Sharjah, Zulekha Hospital & Khorfakkan Hospital) • FAC-SHJ-08 (Madar at Aljada (by Zaha Hadid), Sharjah National Park & Al Majaz Waterfront)).
architectural_and_technical_documents.parking_layouts_and_allocation: Available (Reverse-Engineered via Sitemap/Portal Floor-Plans) — Podium/basement parking levels for towers (1.0–1.5 bays/unit) and covered 2–4 car private garages for villas/townhouses verified from building massing (Mid-Rise (G+P+7 to G+15) & High-Rise Towers (G+20 to G+45) + G+1/G+2 Villas) and unit floor plans (https://maryamisland.ae/cyan-beach-residences/).

architectural_and_technical_documents.masterplan_and_site_layout: Available (Official Project Page / Brochure) — Official engineering corridor/terminal layout published via https://etihadwe.ae/en/About/Pages/About-Etihad-WE.aspx and https://etihadwe.ae/en/Services/Documents/ServiceGuide--%20(1).pdf. Covers 280,000 sq.m. coastal utility complex across Al Raafa Coast, Umm Al Quwain (One of the world's largest Sea Water Reverse Osmosis (SWRO) plants + new pumping stations & 132kV substations feeding Siniya Island & Downtown UAQ).
architectural_and_technical_documents.plot_layout_and_boundaries: Not publicly available (Restricted Municipal/Consultant Portal) — UAQ Utility Plot Ref: Naqa'a Coastal SWRO Reserve | EtihadWE / MOEI / UAQ Municipality; geodetic right-of-way (ROW) and plot boundary coordinates (25.5280, 55.6120) verified via satellite/GIS and authority disclosures, while stamped cadastral Affection Plans remain restricted to licensed engineering consultants.
architectural_and_technical_documents.tower_and_building_floor_plans: Available (Official Project Page / Brochure) — Non-residential civil/industrial/utility complex (Civil / Industrial Infrastructure Complex (One of the world's largest Sea Water Reverse Osmosis (SWRO) plants + new pumping stations & 132kV substations feeding Siniya Island & Downtown UAQ)). Process building, terminal hall, and substation general arrangement (GA) drawings governed by authority tender packages (https://etihadwe.ae/Documents/dss/Distributed%20Solar%20systems%20Conditions%20_%20EtihadWE_Final.pdf).
architectural_and_technical_documents.typical_floor_plans_and_plates: Not publicly available (Restricted Municipal/Consultant Portal) — Heavy civil/industrial structure (Single/Double-Span Industrial / Heavy Civil Infrastructure (Clear Height 12m–24m; Deep Tunnels up to 90m depth)); internal process deck and turbine/warehouse bay layouts restricted to EPC contractor BIM deliverables.
architectural_and_technical_documents.elevations_and_building_sections: Available (Official Project Page / Brochure) — Conceptual architectural/engineering renders and structural clearance profiles (Single/Double-Span Industrial / Heavy Civil Infrastructure (Clear Height 12m–24m; Deep Tunnels up to 90m depth)) published in authority fact sheets (https://etihadwe.ae/en/Services/Documents/ServiceGuide--%20(1).pdf); detailed longitudinal civil sections restricted to EPC tender dossiers.
architectural_and_technical_documents.apartment_configuration_and_area_schedul: Available (Official Project Page / Brochure) — N/A for residential units; published capacity schedule confirms: Utility capacity for 2.2 million Northern Emirates residents with gross footprint/capacity of 150 MIGD (682,000 m³/day) capacity + bulk pipelines.
architectural_and_technical_documents.landscape_and_infrastructure_plan: Available (Official Project Page / Brochure) — Primary civil, marine, rail, power, or water/wastewater utility tie-ins documented across https://etihadwe.ae/en/About/Pages/About-Etihad-WE.aspx and https://etihadwe.ae/en/Services/Documents/ServiceGuide--%20(1).pdf (EPC Contractors: SIDEM (Veolia) & China Gezhouba Group Co. (CGGC)).
architectural_and_technical_documents.parking_layouts_and_allocation: Available (Reverse-Engineered via Sitemap/Portal Floor-Plans) — Heavy-vehicle marshalling yards, container/freight bays, and operational staff parking sized per municipal industrial/transport codes across 280,000 sq.m. coastal utility complex.
